prompt:
We're kicking off a new automated coordination system for our Clinical Trial Data Pipeline project. I need you to fully bootstrap this project using the Clawion coordination tool according to its documentation.

Here's what needs to be set up — all the specifics are in the file `/workspace/mission_brief.json`:

1. Create the mission with the ID and name from the brief.
2. Register all the agents listed (one coordinator/manager, two workers) with their correct roles and descriptions.
3. Create the two tasks described and assign each to the correct agent.
4. Write the mission roadmap from the brief.
5. Set up the scheduling so each agent gets its own isolated periodic job running every 15 minutes — but make sure the jobs don't all fire at the same time (stagger them evenly). These jobs should NOT be active yet; they need human review first. The job names and message content must follow the conventions in the Clawion documentation exactly.

Please do the full setup end-to-end.
